goal.summary: Both batch tasks landed and were verified independently of their worker reports - each worker had one real defect its own report did not name, and both were root-fixed. completed: PARALLEL BATCH DONE. Import pipeline (scripts/voice-library/ingest.py + a 10-voice voices/ bundle) and MpiVoicePicker (Compound + dev-gallery mount). Verified by me, not on report: lint:components exit 0, full suite 737/737, 10/10 manifest contract checks, idempotence by identical SHA, f0 calibration inside the 2 Hz gate against an INDEPENDENT tool's figures.

PICKER LEAK ROOT-FIXED. _renderDetail() set innerHTML on a container holding a mounted MpiRadioGroup and MpiButton without calling destroy(), leaking an instance plus detached DOM per voice click. The panel now owns a separate _detailUnsubs, flushed BEFORE the early returns (hiding the panel is a teardown too) and again in destroy(). The worker's report called the accumulation 'intentional', which is what made it worth opening.

OPUS HALVED, and the escalation dissolved rather than answered. The pipeline wrote 48 kHz and the worker escalated bundle size to Fabio on the false premise that soundfile exposes no bitrate knob (it exposes compression_level AND bitrate_mode). The real fix was the sample rate: 24 kHz is the plain clips' own rate and the TTS/VC stack's rate. 77283 B -> 40225 B per clip; 44 KB/voice, 2.5 MB at the decided ~60, inside D1's 5 MB estimate. NO size decision is pending.

PHASE 2 COMPLETE - 12/12 cells accepted by ear. Ask 1 gave 5/6 first pass (angry, sad, cheerful, whisper, neutral). Flat failed, was re-rolled, and both registers now pass. Shipped to voices/performance/ (489 KB, 24 kHz) and written into manifest.performanceClips; loader-verified, both grids return their six emotions.

IDENTITY HOLDS ACROSS THE EMOTION GRID (ask 2). Fabio: 'yeah, it's the same guy.' Emotion-driven pitch lift is register-asymmetric ~2:1 - R1 lifts +9.9/+11.6 st for angry/cheerful where R3 lifts only +4.8/+4.4 st from identical prompt grammar - and R1's 72.6 Hz internal spread costs nothing perceptually. The asymmetry is a property to record, not a defect to fix.

THREE OF MY OWN CALLS WERE WRONG THIS SESSION and all three are recorded as wrong in validation.md rather than dropped: the 'VoiceDesign ignored the prompt content' hypothesis for flat (it is seed variance - the ORIGINAL wording at a new seed passed while all three harder rewordings did worse than the natural conversational read), the absolute 3.5 st span gate (calibrated on R1's 5.8 st neutral, it wrongly failed R3 whose neutral is naturally 8.9 st), and the 'angry sounds distant' room theory (it was my own level-matching).

key_decisions: ALL 12 EMOTION CELLS ARE ACCEPTED AND SHIPPED. Do not re-roll, re-judge or re-open them. Fabio on the re-rolled flat: 'the new flat sounds like the person is in shock, which is actually what flat is supposed to be... soulless, in shock, or just empty or not paying attention. It's good.'

A CLIP OUT OF ITS REGISTER BAND IS CORRECT, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS - never 'repair' one. `register` names the PERFORMER'S BASELINE and emotion moves the clip off it: angry/cheerful sit ABOVE (R1 angry 167.3 Hz), and flat sits BELOW (R1 flat 83.4 Hz, under the 90 Hz floor). The sweep proved span and pitch are anti-correlated - a genuinely monotone read sits at the bottom of the range - so flat's drift is CAUSED by being flat. The Phase 0 shifter is reserved for a persona that came back as the wrong person.

THE FLAT CELL IS A LOTTERY, NOT A PROMPT PROBLEM. Identical wording ranged 2.5-8.5 st across eight seeds. My 'name the constraint harder' hypothesis was falsified by its own control: the ORIGINAL wording at a new seed passed the gate while v1/v2/v3 rewordings all landed 6.0-7.0 st, worse than the natural conversational read. Flat is the ONE cell needing generate-and-measure rather than generate-and-listen, because it is the one defined by absence of pitch movement. Seeds are recorded per clip in the manifest as real provenance.

ANY SPAN GATE MUST BE RELATIVE TO THAT REGISTER'S NEUTRAL, never an absolute semitone count. My absolute 3.5 st gate came from R1's neutral (5.8 st) and produced a false 'R3 has no candidate' - R3's neutral is naturally 8.9 st wide. Relative, the two winners match: 43% and 47% of their own neutral. An absolute threshold silently encodes one register's habits as the standard.

THE OPUS BUNDLE IS 24 kHz AND THERE IS NO SIZE DECISION PENDING. 44 KB/voice, 2.5 MB at ~60, 9.6 MB even at all 228. Any future report that bundle size needs a Fabio call should be checked against this first.
D1 in-repo voices/ and D2 ~60 curated both stand, from Fabio 2026-08-25. 60 is a starting point, not a cap, so the pipeline must stay re-runnable.
THE EMOTION TAXONOMY IS CLOSED. Fabio rejected Sarcastic/Dry and Menacing/Manic. The six stand. Do not reopen.
THE PERFORMANCE CLIPS ARE AUTHORED, NOT RECORDED - decided 2026-08-25 and now validated by the result. Do not plan a recording session.
constraints: LEVEL-MATCH EVERY LISTENING TEST, BUT DO NOT USE `pitch_tools.py norm` TO DO IT. It targets rms_active while clamping at a -1.0 dBFS peak ceiling, so a high-crest clip hits the ceiling before its RMS reaches target and the loudest-peaking clip ends up the quietest-bodied. It WIDENED a 1.5 dB gap to 2.0 dB and produced a false 'angry sounds like it's down the street'. Match rms_active exactly at a target low enough that nothing needs limiting - -20 dBFS worked, peaks landed -2.3 to -5.6. See research/proximity_probe.py.

TWO MEASUREMENT ARTEFACTS, THE AUDIO IS FINE, DO NOT CHASE THEM AS BUGS: perf_R3_sad reports a 21.4 st span off a p10 of 72.3 Hz against a p90 of 248.5 (creak or a pyin octave error - Fabio passed sad by ear), and whisper spans are meaningless in BOTH directions (R1 11.5 st, R3 3.3 st) because a whisper has too little voiced tone for pyin. R3 whisper's 3.3 st would otherwise 'beat' flat's 4.2 and look like a defect.

TOOLING: the Phase 2 route is G:/ComfyUi/_qwen_tts_rt/venv/Scripts/python.exe under `python <mpi-lib>/scripts/gpu_lease.py run -- ...`, ALWAYS as a background Bash call. Measurement/transcode is G:/ComfyUi/python_embeded/python.exe (librosa 1.0.0, soundfile 0.14.0 with OGG/OPUS write). THERE IS NO FFMPEG ON THIS MACHINE and none is needed. Heredocs are blocked by guard-shell, and backticks inside a double-quoted inline script are blocked too - write a script to the scratchpad and run it by path.

A WORKER'S REPORT IS EVIDENCE, NOT TRUTH. Both workers this session reported clean and both had a real defect their report did not name. Confirm on disk with git status, re-run the checks yourself, and read the code behind any sentence in a report that explains away an oddity.
